name: Mocking SpongeBob
look: A cartoon still of SpongeBob bent forward in a hunched, chicken-like pose, eyes pointing in different directions and mouth hanging open in a dopey expression. He wears his white Krusty Krab hat in a room with a blue wall and green floor.
use: Someone's words are repeated back in alternating upper and lowercase letters to imitate a whiny, mocking voice, ridiculing the statement as dumb, smug or hypocritical.
slots: the same words in mocking alternating caps (bottom)
describe: spongebob bent over like a chicken making a dumb face
sponge cartoon repeating what someone said in a silly voice
spongebob with weird eyes and mouth open hunched over
yellow cartoon character imitating someone sarcastically
text written in alternating capital letters with spongebob
origin: From the SpongeBob SquarePants episode Little Yellow Book, where SpongeBob acts like a chicken; the meme took off in 2017.
